ai_provisions: Article 31 — Artificial Intelligence: cooperation on research and industry practices, responsible adoption, commercialisation; ethical governance frameworks; alignment through regional and international fora; consideration of internationally recognised principles
relevance.excluded_scope: Article 31 uses 'shall cooperate' and 'shall endeavour'; it does not impose product requirements, prohibitions or enforcement obligations specific to AI.
relevance.reason: A bilateral digital-economy agreement that replaces the electronic-commerce chapter of the Singapore-Australia Free Trade Agreement and contains a dedicated article on artificial intelligence. The AI article is cooperative and expressly refers to internationally recognised principles and AI governance frameworks.
